plugins.name: airprompter
plugins.description: AirPrompter connects Claude to your saved prompt and workflow library. Create, run, and improve reusable multi-step AI workflows: a guided interview captures how YOU do a task (your sources, judgments, and quality bar), generates each workflow step as a purpose-built prompt, and saves it to your library for repeatable runs across your AI tools. Includes secure sign-in to the AirPrompter MCP server for authenticated reads, writes, and workflow runs. AirPrompter keeps a record of each run, including your inputs, step status, timing, and token counts; the README explains what is recorded.
